question:
An image tagger gave the tag "{tag}" to a picture of an illustrated character. Which kind of tag is it?
A = {A}.
B = {B}.
C = {C}.
Answer with one letter: A, B or C.

kinds_described.body: a permanent trait of the character's own body that must look the same in any new picture of this character (species or body type, fur, scales, skin colour, face, nose or muzzle, hair colour, hair length, eye colour, ears, tail, wings, horns, body markings, scars, tattoos, build)
kinds_described.outfit: clothing, footwear, jewellery or an accessory the character is wearing
kinds_described.scene: something that changes from picture to picture (pose, action, gesture, expression, gaze, camera angle, framing, background, place, weather, lighting, objects held or nearby, other people, number of people, art style, image quality)

calibration: 문맥 보정(N/A), 순서 세 번 평균
